nodes.description: Constant mint price in wei (0.033 ether) used to validate payment in mintRegenz.
Constant maximum number of tokens, used as mint cap and modulus for index randomization.
Constant reveal timestamp compared with block.timestamp in mintRegenz to trigger starting index block.
Constant maximum tokens mintable per transaction.
Constant number of tokens reserved for the owner in reserveRegenz.
Randomized starting index for metadata shuffling; set in setStartingIndex and read in tokenURI.
Block number recorded when sale condition is met, used as entropy source in setStartingIndex.
Payable address authorized to withdraw contract balance via claimETH.
Sale pause flag toggled by flipSaleState and required by mintRegenz.
Mapping of buyer address to record of minted token ids.
Public payable mint function; enforces sale active, per-tx and supply caps, price, and records purchases.
Public function that derives startingIndex from blockhash of startingIndexBlock (weak randomness).
Public function transferring the full contract balance to claimEthAddress when called by it.
Owner-only function minting NUM_TO_RESERVE tokens to msg.sender.
Owner-only function toggling saleIsActive.
Owner-only function setting the ERC721 base URI.
Overridden tokenURI applying startingIndex modular shift to the requested tokenId.
Public view returning the list of token ids minted by a wallet.
Constructor initializing ERC721 name/symbol and setting claimEthAddress.
Attacker-controllable caller address used for authorization, minting recipient and ownership checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintRegenz.
Native ETH transfer of address(this).balance to claimEthAddress inside claimETH.
Use of blockhash for pseudo-random startingIndex derivation, predictable by miners.
Caller-supplied number of tokens to mint in mintRegenz.
Caller-supplied base URI string for setBaseURI.
Token id argument of tokenURI.
Wallet address argument of getMintedRegenz.
Constructor argument stored into claimEthAddress.
Local snapshot of totalSupply() in reserveRegenz used as mint id base.
Loop counter used in reserveRegenz and mintRegenz mint loops.
Local token id computed as totalSupply() in each mintRegenz iteration.
Local shifted token id (tokenId + startingIndex) % TOTAL_SUPPLY in tokenURI.

edges.reason: numberOfTokens bounds the mint loop and is checked against MAX_PER_TX.
MAX_PER_TX limits the user-supplied numberOfTokens.
TOTAL_SUPPLY caps totalSupply()+numberOfTokens in mintRegenz.
PRICE is multiplied with numberOfTokens for the msg.value check.
saleIsActive must be true for mintRegenz to execute.
mintRegenz writes minted ids into regenzBought.
msg.sender is the mint recipient and record owner in mintRegenz.
mintRegenz sets startingIndexBlock when conditions are met.
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, making the starting index block miner-dependent.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP (constant) is used as the timestamp threshold in mintRegenz.
mintIndex local is computed and minted each iteration.
loop counter i drives the mint loop in mintRegenz.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is the modulus applied to the blockhash result in setStartingIndex.
setStartingIndex requires startingIndex to be zero before assigning it.
startingIndexBlock is the block whose hash is used as entropy.
blockhash-derived value controls startingIndex, a predictable pseudo-randomness source.
setStartingIndex writes the computed value into startingIndex.
tokenURI shifts the requested id using startingIndex.
TOTAL_SUPPLY is used as the modulus in tokenURI id shifting.
tokenId argument is transformed into the shifted id in tokenURI.
moddedId local is computed and passed to super.tokenURI.
baseURI argument is written via _setBaseURI in setBaseURI.
reserveRegenz mints reserved tokens to msg.sender under onlyOwner.
NUM_TO_RESERVE bounds the reservation loop.
supply local snapshots totalSupply() as mint id base in reserveRegenz.
loop counter i drives the reservation loop in reserveRegenz.
claimETH authorizes based on claimEthAddress equality with msg.sender.
msg.sender is compared to claimEthAddress to gate the withdrawal.
claimETH performs a native ETH transfer of the full balance to an external address.
constructor argument _claimEthAddress initializes claimEthAddress.
constructor writes the payable claim address state variable.
wallet argument selects the regenzBought record in getMintedRegenz.
getMintedRegenz reads the regenzBought mapping array.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
flipSaleState is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
setBaseURI is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter numberOfTokens only exists to bound and price the mint loop in mintRegenz.
Parameter baseURI is used only as the new base URI inside setBaseURI.
Parameter tokenId is only consumed by the tokenURI id-shifting logic.
Parameter wallet is only used to index regenzBought in getMintedRegenz.
Constructor argument _claimEthAddress is directly assigned to the claimEthAddress state variable.
Local supply is a temporary totalSupply snapshot used solely inside reserveRegenz.
Loop counter i is a transient index for the reservation loop in reserveRegenz.
Local mintIndex is a transient token id computed per iteration in mintRegenz.
Local moddedId is a transient shifted id computed only in tokenURI.
